site.name: Meijer
site.address: 3175 S Rochester Rd, Rochester Hills, MI 48307
site.sharedCabinetNote: Owner confirmed no vehicle on the paired connector, so the full cabinet output was available.

conditions.assumedNote: Not instrumented. Inferred from a mid-August Michigan evening. Any fit that leans on temperature must treat this as soft.

session.sessionCapNote: EVgo displays and enforces a 120-minute cap on DC sessions.

receipt.note: Session Fee itemised at $0.00 -- the PlusMax waiver applied as published. An earlier reading of the app data appeared to show a $0.99 fixed fee; that was an artifact of fitting a line through laggy app readings while omitting sales tax, not a real charge.

instrumentDisagreement.detail: At 21:59 the phone app reported 78.29 kWh. Fifty-two seconds later the charger screen reported 81.9815 kWh -- 3.69 kWh apart, where 52 s at 30 kW is worth 0.43 kWh. The app's energy and cost tiles lag the dispenser by minutes. Its instantaneous kW tile is worse: it read 45 kW at a moment its own energy counter proves the truck was averaging 106 kW.
instrumentDisagreement.rule: The dispenser is the meter. The app is a lagging summary of it. Fit to the charger screen and the settled receipt; use app readings only for cost-versus-energy relationships, where both tiles lag together.

derivedFacts: Effective all-in price $0.3286/kWh ($0.31 + 6% Michigan sales tax). Every charger-screen reading matches rate x kWh x 1.06 to the cent.
62% to 99% is 37 SOC points = 78.7 kWh into a 212.7 kWh pack against 82.6275 kWh dispensed, implying 95.2% DC charging efficiency.
The final 13 minutes dispensed 4.90 kWh to move one SOC point -- about 2.13 kWh of storage for 4.90 kWh bought, roughly 40% efficient. Cell balancing and heat, not range.

modelDisagreement.note: The shipped estimated curve predicts about 86 minutes for the 62->97% portion of this session. It took 41. The curve appears to be roughly 2x too pessimistic above 55% SOC.
modelDisagreement.action: Recorded, not fitted. One session covers one SOC window at one temperature on one station; refitting to it would trade one wrong curve for a differently wrong curve still carrying a confident label.

vehicleDashAfter.note: Dash range is the truck's rolling estimate from recent driving, not a measurement of pack capacity.

source: Owner photographs of the EVgo phone app, the charger screen mid-session, the settled receipt screen, and the vehicle dash.
